coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left. x0,y0,x1,y1 is the printed blank itself (the ink of the underscore run or of the drawn rule). write is the line-high area above it where a value goes (12 pt above the bottom of the rule): the scorer matches fields to write.
how_measured: characters from pdfplumber (underscore runs: x from the first and last underscore character, without the label or punctuation glued to the run); drawn rules from the page content stream via pypdf (thin filled rectangles); the y of each underscore rule from the ink of a 288 dpi pdftoppm render; every page rendered at 100 dpi and looked at; overlays truth-overlay-pNN.png looked at

signing.kind: a subscription agreement template made for an investor-portal product that adds the investor questionnaire, the investor signature page and the firm acceptance page itself. The PDF as supplied prints none of them.

investor_signature_block.note: the text refers to a signature page and to a subscription amount line on it; neither is printed in this file

firm_block.note: the text refers to an acceptance page signed for the firm; it is not printed in this file

who: page 18: the professional (attorney, accountant, broker-dealer or investment adviser) who writes a letter confirming the investor is accredited
page 20: the broker-dealer or adviser firm, its registered representative, its principal; and details of a custodian (if applicable)
